reason: Machine lens: the removed LDA &B2 / STA zp_save+21 / LDA &B3 / STA zp_save+22 are LDA zp (A5, 3 cycles, 2 bytes) and STA abs (8D, 4 cycles, 3 bytes): 14 cycles and 10 bytes, straight-line with no page-crossing or branch terms, so the claim stands. No new opcodes. Nothing reads &BC15/&BC16: zp_save is used only in render_zp.6502 (restore's LDA zp_save+21 is already dead, overwritten by LDA zp_save+23; no load of +22) and the start-up zeroing (STA REN_BASE+&800,Y); no other symbol sits at &BC15/&BC16; no self-modified operands in save_game_zp. &B2/&B3 are put back by render's buffer_to_view (X=2) from view_to_buffer's slot 2, as accepted G0257 relies on. A, flags dead: the next LDA overwrites A, RTS follows the last pair. Shift of -10 bytes on everything after it up to the &9000 SKIP (checked in build/strykers.lst and build/strykers-gameplay.lst): shipping build, the only page-crossing branches (BMI near at &8EF6, BCC near at &8EFC in sky_off) cross before and after, no change; indexed reads there use tables outside the shifted region. Gameplay build: only the start-up zeroing loops change (BPL zero_rv_128 stops crossing, BPL zero_rv_56 starts), run once at start-up, not per pass; BEQ arrived crosses before and after. Callers reach save/restore by JSR/JMP to labels, so the move is safe.
